title: Hackers Abuse FortiGate and SonicWall VPN Access to Infiltrate Enterprise Networks
content_md: An enterprise intrusion operation linked to the handle tcherber, recovering more than 500 FortiGate VPN credential entries and logs showing successful tunnels into multiple victim networks in May and June 2026. The findings establish unauthorized access through FortiGate tunnels, not a confirmed SonicWall breach or exploitation of a newly disclosed VPN vulnerability.
